type: method-implementation + Ising validation (C_TTT spin-resolved extraction, Route A)
hardware: local CPU. qw_ope_cttt.jl (includes qw_ope_pev_z2.jl machinery via main-guard). Design: CTTT-SPIN-RESOLUTION-DESIGN.md.
goal: Implement Route A (T from ascended energy density h [refl-even, T+Tbar] + momentum density p=i[h,h'] [refl-odd, T-Tbar]; project onto the Delta~2 even one-site block; PEV-normalize; 3-pt with EXACT h=2 kinematics). Validation gate: C_TTT = 2*sqrt(2)/sqrt(c) = 4.000 on Ising BEFORE the novel TCI 3.381.
implementation_notes: Two deviations from the design doc, both recorded in the driver header: (1) design Eq. A4 fixes the h/p relative phase by convention, but the phase is invisible to the 2-pt metric (Route D's U(2) degeneracy) -- driver scans theta in {0,pi/2,pi,3pi/2}, T(theta)=(O+ + e^{i theta}O-)/sqrt(2), selecting theta* by MIN |C_TTbarI| (structural zero, unbiased), not max |C_TTT|. With real (Float64) MERA tensors, O+ is real and O- purely imaginary, so the theta=0/pi class is the genuinely chiral complex combination -- consistently selected on clean seeds. (2) block basis orthonormalized under the rho2 metric before projection (raw eigsolve vectors near-degenerate -> ill-conditioned Gram; chi=6 seed 3 gave C_TTT=120 from exactly this).

results.chi6_smoke:
3 seeds x 2500: ALL structural gates pass every seed (G3 chiral split = 0.0000 [structural: reflection symmetry of rho2 with real tensors];

~1e-17, herm(p)=0; C_sss=0 exact; pin C_sse=0.47-0.51). Block-quality res_h discriminates perfectly: res_h=0.17 -> C_TTT=3.66 (8.5% from 4.000, regA/B 3.69/3.63); res_h=0.8 -> 6.7; res_h=3.3 -> 120 (Gram conditioning, fixed).
results.chi8_v1: 6 seeds x 3000 (single-sided rho1-weighted reduction): sector dims pristine (5/6 clean, D_T 1.996-2.007) and G4=|C_TTbarI| <= 0.007 everywhere, but res_h DEGRADED (0.38-2.3, none under the 0.35 gate) and C_TTT scattered 3.0-9.3. Diagnostic: p_side_ratio ~0.8 = the two side-reductions of the reflection-ODD p are mostly ALIGNED -> the single-sided one-site reduction admits reflection-even contamination.
results.fix_in_flight: parity-resolved reduction (h -> symmetric side combination, p -> antisymmetric, with collapse fallback + flag); chi=8 v2 rerun launched 2026-07-14 (cttt_chi8_v2.log).
results.chi8_v2: PARITY-RESOLVED REDUCTION FALSIFIED: sym(h)/antisym(p) side-combinations made res_h/res_p strictly worse (seed2 res_h 0.38->2.24) and widened C_TTT scatter to 2.2-11.3. Conclusion: the reflection action on one-site fixed-point operators is NOT the naive side-swap (transpose twist suspected). Driver reverted to single-sided reduction (the empirically better variant).
results.v3_rho3_pairing_2026_07_15: REDESIGN: reduction step ELIMINATED. Block coefficients measured via genuine 3-site correlators <phi_i(1) O(2,3)> and <O(1,2) phi_i(3)> against the reflection-symmetric rho3avg; block orthonormalized jointly with {1, eps}. Two bugs found and fixed on the way: (a) leg-swap of a BLOCKED operator is not spatial reflection -- needs intra-block reversal R (R (x) R conjugation); with it, h_refl = p_refl = 0 exactly. (b) the relative L/R pairing sign at the SI level is GAUGE-dependent (non-covariant tensors): assuming it annihilates the signal on half the seeds; fixed with per-seed self-calibrating sign.
results.chi6_v31: BEST MEASUREMENT YET, ALL GATES PASS ON SEED 1: C_TTT = 4.20 vs 4.000 (5%), regA/B = 4.23/4.17, G4 = |C_TTbarI| = 0.0011 (structural zero), fracs 0.998/0.999, pin C_sse = 0.505. Seeds 2-3 give junk (12.2/67.5) but G4 FLAGS THEM (0.12/0.15, 100x seed 1) -- G4 is the per-seed discriminant for C_TTT exactly as C_sss was for the sigma-eps pipeline. Clean-filter now includes G4<0.05.
results.chi8_v31: HONEST MISS: 8 seeds, 6 pass the G4<0.05 + fracs gate but |C_TTT| scatters 0.58-59.3 -- at chi=8 the structural zero no longer implies a converged number (G4 discriminated perfectly at chi=6, not at chi=8). Block towers at chi=8 are junky ([1.74,1.78,2.04,2.17]-type), so the Delta~2 block basis itself is polluted; theta* class also flips seed-to-seed, another instability signature. NOT the pairing mechanism (chi=6 full-gate pass stands). Discriminating experiment in flight: chi=6 x 8 seeds -- if several reproduce ~4.2, chi=6 extraction is stable and chi=8 needs tower convergence (longer maxiter / higher chi); if only the one seed works, it was luck.
results.chi6_v31_8seed: STABILITY CHECK: 8 seeds, 5 pass all gates (G4 correctly rejects 3 junk seeds incl. a 67.5 and a 52.9). Clean values: 4.20, 3.71, 2.13, 1.95, 11.87 -- TWO seeds within 8% of the 4.000 target but NOT basin-stable. Theta-class analysis rules out phase selection as the cause (neither class is uniformly ~4). Residual instability isolated to the Delta~2 BLOCK BASIS: at chi=6/8 the [1.6,2.4] window catches a seed-dependent mix of true {T,Tbar} and lattice junk operators (blocks like [1.97,1.98,2.07,2.24] vs [1.67,1.82,2.03,2.19]). All structural physics now verified: exact blocked-reflection (R-corrected), gauge-sign self-calibration, G4 discriminant, normalization pin.

verdict: ROUTE A CLOSED (see SIM-2026-066): the chi=10/12 RunPod escalation FALSIFIED the finite-chi-convergence hypothesis -- scatter worsened with chi and the full gate stack can be satisfied exactly while the number is arbitrary. The one-site Delta~2 eigenbasis does not support stable {T,Tbar} extraction via physical-operator pairing (isometry-only superoperator breaks the translation covariance spin-2 requires). The chi=6 hits 4.20/3.71 are unclaimable. Everything VALIDATED along the way stands: rho3-correlator pairing, exact blocked-reflection (R-correction), gauge-sign self-calibration, G4 as a chiral-split certificate. Successor: Route B (width-2 translation-phase eigenbasis).
